# Bartimaeus Cries Out (Mark 10:47)

## Emotional Focus
Calling out to Jesus when you need help.

## Key KJV
“Jesus, thou son of David, have mercy on me.” (Mark 10:47)

## Gentle Retelling
Blind Bartimaeus kept calling, “Jesus, have mercy on me!” Jesus stopped and healed him because He heard the prayer.

## Coloring Prompt
Bartimaeus calling out with arms raised while Jesus turns toward him.

## Read-Along Flow + Response
“You can call out to Jesus anytime — He stops and hears.”
